page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a centred title block at the top above a full-width dedication heading. No margin notes. The printed page is the right-hand page of the opening, so it has no running head or page number. The signature "A 2" and catchword "generosæ" stand at the foot.

main_text.l: tui[?] nominis præsidio prodeat in vulgus.
iubens merito: Ad te, inquam, ho-
minem, ut ex aliis audio, (& est perr-
aro mendax in melius fama,) cùm

page.notes: The left edge is cut by the binding, so the first letters of several lines are partly hidden: "tui" (line 4), "viulgus" read as "vulgus", "iubens", "hominem", "natalium" (the initial n is barely visible). Marked [?] where the letter is not clearly readable. The opening "A" is a large woodcut drop cap joined to "VET", transcribed as AVET. The faint text on the right and top is show-through from the reverse side and is left out. The title and dedication lines are set in spaced capitals and italics, transcribed as one heading.
